pages.text: Craft a Rift Keystone and open your first Rift. RFTools Dimensions powers Oblivion's Rift, the pack's procedural endgame loop.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Oblivion's Rift uses RFTools Dimensions to generate procedural dungeon dimensions, and every Rift run is a dimension of its own.$(br2)$(bold)Rift Keystone:$() You need one to open a Rift portal. It is crafted from Rift Shards (the endgame currency) and boss materials.
$(bold)Dimension safety:$() A Rift dimension is single-use and collapses when the run timer expires. If you have not left by then, you are ejected. Bring a warp scroll.

$(bold)No book needed.$() RFTools Dimensions is documented in JEI and on the $(bold)RFTools wiki$(). The core loop is the Dimension Builder and the Dimlet system: craft Dimlets to set a dimension's properties, insert them into a Dimension Tab and power the builder.$(br2)$(bold)Next: bank Rift Shards$() ($(l:icraft:loot/rift_economy)Rift Shard Economy$(/l)).
